conceptual_change: Implement a volatility gate using a 14-period Average True Range (ATR) with a 1.5x multiplier to restrict entry execution to periods where the current ATR exceeds the 1.5x threshold relative to the 20-period moving average of the ATR.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt was rejected due to the absence of a concrete engine implementation for the volatility filter; this hypothesis defines the specific trigger mechanism required for programmatic execution.
